name: What is the average cost of adding a second story in the Las Vegas area?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of adding a second story in the Las Vegas area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of adding a second story in the Las Vegas area can vary significantly based on factors such as the size of the addition, materials chosen, interior finishes, and the complexity of structural work. While it's difficult to give an exact average without a detailed assessment, homeowners can generally expect costs to range from $150,000 to over $400,000. It's best to obtain a detailed quote after an on-site evaluation.
